Prevalence of flavored product use among current users
Among current users of any tobacco product, 64.1% reported using at least one flavored tobacco product in the past 30 days.
a significant nonlinear decrease occurred during 2014–2018 in use of any flavored tobacco product (from 73.0% to 67.4%)
NYTS is an annual cross-sectional, school-based, self-administered, pencil-and-paper questionnaire
This report uses data from five NYTS waves (2014–2018).
For each school type, presence of linear and nonlinear (i.e., quadratic) trends were assessed during 2014–2018.

methods_quotes.q: Data were weighted to account for the complex survey design and adjusted for nonresponse; national prevalence estimates were calculated with 95% confidence intervals.
For each school type, presence of linear and nonlinear (i.e., quadratic) trends were assessed during 2014–2018.
A test for linear trend is significant if an overall statistically significant decrease or increase occurs during the study period.
For all analyses, p-values <0.05 were considered statistically significant.
Dashes indicate data are statistically unreliable because the sample size was <50 or the relative standard error was >30%.
